panels.description: Tall cutaway of the infrastructure spine from Keel to Oasis. A single amber alert pulse travels upward through existing water, energy and control infrastructure; nodes flicker in sequence. This is only a transmission alert, not artifact authentication or authority transfer. No lettering; keep the spine unobstructed.

Symmetrical Oasis control room with pearl-white and graphite surfaces and a wall-sized mountain display. One amber Keel point pulses. Mera sits small against it; her clean water glass is aligned with the desk edge. Leave upper-left clear.
Cold-white monitor with a completely blank interface area reserved for lettering. Generate no text, buttons or duplicate selection graphics in the artwork.
Mera nudges the clean water glass a few millimeters until it aligns with the desk edge and monitor frame. No lettering.

The amber Keel point continues pulsing as a thin cold-white ring closes around it. Mera is tiny in the display reflection. Reserve a clear lower-left zone for the retrospective caption and a separate clear lower-right zone for the chapter marker, with a wide gap between them.

items.text: LEGACY PROTOCOL DETECTED · SOURCE: KEEL SECTOR · [ REPORT TO ALPHA ] [ TRACK ]
I told myself I was only checking. Most of the true things in my life started that way.
